removals.intro: Taking a project out of Value Bridge needs two platform admins: one asks, a different one approves, and the operator runs it at least 24 hours later. While a request is open the project cannot be changed.
removals.fewAdmins: Only {n} live platform admin. Every removal needs two: add a second platform admin before any project can be archived or deleted.
removals.due.title: Due for archiving
removals.due.none: No project is due. A project comes due two years after it was closed.
removals.backlog.title: Archive files still owed
removals.backlog.none: Every frozen baseline has its archive file.
removals.list.title: Requests
removals.new.title: Request a removal
removals.new.reason: Reason (the contract clause or Ben's instruction)
removals.confirm.label: Type {expected} to confirm
removals.confirm.requestBody: From the moment you confirm, nobody can change this project until the request is cancelled or carried out.
removals.confirm.deleteArchiveBody: The project left Value Bridge when it was archived. Once a second platform admin approves and the operator runs it, the project's keys are destroyed and every archive file of it becomes unreadable for good.
removals.confirm.approveBody: Requested by {who} on {when}. Reason: {reason}. The operator can carry it out 24 hours after your approval; it cannot be undone.
removals.confirm.cancelBody: The project can be changed again at once.
removals.archive.label: Archive file
removals.weekly.title: Weekly archive check
removals.weekly.loadFailed: The weekly archive check's status could not be loaded. Reload the page; if it stays, call Fortience IS.
removals.weekly.never: The weekly archive check has never run. Ask Fortience IS to schedule it.
removals.weekly.stale: The weekly archive check last ran {when} — more than 8 days ago. Ask Fortience IS why.
removals.weekly.line: Last run {when}: {due} due for archiving · {reopened} reopened · {owed} file(s) owed · {failed} file(s) failed their check · {held} archived project(s) checked, {heldFailing} failing · {removals} removal(s) unfinished
removals.weekly.heldFailing: The archive of {code} failed its check on {when}: {error}. It is the only copy — call Fortience IS now.
removals.weekly.noGrant: {n} live platform admin(s) have no grant on record and can approve nothing until Fortience IS records one.
removals.weekly.oldRequests: {n} request(s) for admin rights have waited more than 7 days.
removals.weekly.recentGrants: {n} admin request(s) approved in the last 7 days.
removals.weekly.ownerGrants: {n} admin grant(s) recorded by Fortience IS in the last 7 days ({backdated} back-dated).
removals.weekly.noAsker: {n} recorded admin grant(s) name no asking admin.
removals.weekly.removedAdmins: Last 7 days: {removed} admin(s) had their rights removed, {deactivated} deactivated.
